title: Large personal retro audio, Sega assets and BBC tooling discovery
summary: Personally screen 136 candidate URLs and add 33 projects, with one thin tool-bundle exclusion.
notes: Root assistant researched and published this batch personally on main without a worker, PR or branch. Fourteen searches emphasized CPC and AY music, Sega assets, BBC development, Apple graphics and Atari media utilities. Name collisions with unrelated music apps were screened out. Primary implementation and documentation qualify each addition. Historical source, extracted replay routines, host conversion, native ports and prototype limits are distinguished. AI is recorded only from explicit attribution in Baron, Diskette Toolkit and Apple IIe engine; related repositories or configuration files do not inherit that claim. The CPCMix representative contains actual replay disassembly, not merely INCBIN music. Crossware Z80XR is 6502-hosted despite its output architecture. GraphicsGale exporter target discrepancies and speculative Atari copper/timing helpers are explicitly limited. No upstream code, sound player, firmware, disk tool or network fetcher was executed, and no full build/audio/runtime fidelity was independently certified. Immutable links retain large or legacy-encoded source without altering proof bytes.

sources.reason: Native Mac art converter uses platform fonts/palettes and includes Apple II BASIC/ProDOS export; concrete block allocation and disk-writing implementation inspected.
Host YM cruncher and native relocatable replay code target low, song-dependent fixed playback cost.
Music-player extraction collection includes substantive disassembled replay routines, shared headers and author-written menu/FDC/PSG analysis code.
Original BCPL sequencer source models notes, repeats, tempo and envelope controls with sample score files.
Work-in-progress player writes YM register frames via CPC PPI and synchronizes to VSYNC.
Original BASIC program enters notes on three staves and plays polyphonic music; score/display code inspected.
Tiled map processor generates C scene/map data for the related GraphicsGale asset workflow.
Converts indexed GraphicsGale animation into C sprites, tile/frame tables and optional streaming/batched forms.
Exports GraphicsGale level themes into TMX/TSX, bitmap tiles and C metatile data, including animation markers.
Ground-up BeebAsm successor adds scoped expressions, strings/lists, BASIC integration, disk output and liveness-based zero-page allocation.
Editor extension implements tolerant unit parsing, include/scope resolution, semantic highlighting and assembler check integration.
Author recovered a 1985 school-project listing through OCR and debugging; source embeds the text editor in BBC BASIC assembler.
Py8dis recipe analyzes Crossware Z80XR 3.08D, including encoded parser tables, inline strings and symbolic labels.
Annotated Mouse Graphics Toolkit demo adapted to edit system fonts with native menu/event handling.
Native graphics/sprite and one-bit audio experiment with modern bitmap/MIDI asset pipeline; main assembly structures and integration inspected.
Single-file browser editor models lo-res blocks, mixed-mode text, ROM-font glyphs and PNG/JSON design export.
AmigaDOS handler with host-testable ISO/High Sierra/Rock Ridge/Joliet/UDF/HFS backends and media/cache logic.
Cross-platform AY player/library includes tracker format dispatch, emulated Z80 replay paths, conversion and dumping frontends.
Python AY-style tone/noise synthesis and FBD sequencer generate floating-point samples or WAV output.
Android project includes YM parsing, audio rendering and basic selection/play/pause interface.
Plain-C PT3 readers and AY renderer variants adapt Shiru/ZXSSK-style replay with benchmarking/sample harnesses.
Converter and Arduino firmware encode AY register streams into MIDI transport for playback through physical sound hardware.
Native PT2/PT3, SQT, STC and STP player collection adds common loop/fade controls and reusable compile-time setup.
C# port combines PT3 playback, AY effects and analyzer visualization; actual replay state machine inspected.
Offline preparation converts curated source formats into finite YM6 streams, played with pinned WebAssembly chip engine and AudioWorklet channel visualization.
Modernized Megachur player integrates YM/dump/tracker parsing, chip rendering and WebAudio/PWA frontend in one release file.
Aquarius-derived register-stream player adapted to VZ200 AY add-on and video-retrace pacing.
Arranges MIDI into three-channel AY/PT3 data, recovers PT3 notes to MIDI, auditions and packages self-playing tape/snapshot outputs.
Jochen Hippel/Mad Max sound driver converted from 68000 to Z80, retaining original sound data structures.
Pascal tools implement ST directory listing, text conversion and assembler/linker/relocation-related workflows; directory and AS68 code inspected.
Older web suite contains concrete PI1 bitplane/palette conversion and graphics/curve exports.
Windows toolkit analyzes images/flux, merges recovered sectors and supplies device-specific read/write/test backends.
Recursively retrieves uip-tools/NetUSBee directory trees for host storage and Hatari GEMDOS usage.

This candidate mainly packages already separate WLA-DX, MEKA and devkitSMS projects with installation glue and a hello-world example. No distinct reconstruction or substantive independent tool is established; inspected installer also has an inverted MEKA success check.
